card.title: Extract the CLI retry wrapper into its own module
card.body: <!-- sprint-meta risk=R2 spec=2026-09-10-roles-and-souls spec_sha256=deadbeef area=maintenance slug=t_5e6f7a8b -->

args.reason:
DECISION: Should the retry wrapper live in board_bridge.py or a new retry.py?
Why: the CLI call needs a bounded retry and two callers will want it
Class: R2
1. add it to board_bridge.py - keeps the change small but board_bridge grows another concern
2. extract maintenance/retry.py - clean seam, one more file to wire into tests
Recommend: 2 - the seam is worth it once a second caller exists
Learn: if a third caller needs it, extraction is clearly right
